hooks.text: Uranus was the first new planet discovered since antiquity.
Astronomers flatly refused to name Uranus after a king.
The planet Uranus was discovered over 240 years ago.

title: When Uranus Was Almost Named King George
description: When William Herschel discovered Uranus in 1781, he tried to name it after King George III before rival astronomers rejected it.

beats.text: Uranus was the first new planet discovered since antiquity.
beats.visual: Voyager 2 natural color photograph of Uranus, 1986

beats.text: Astronomer William Herschel spotted the faint world using a homemade telescope.
beats.visual: Portrait of astronomer William Herschel by Lemuel Francis Abbott, 1785
queries: William Herschel portrait Lemuel Francis Abbott

beats.text: To gain royal favor, Herschel officially named it after King George.
beats.visual: State portrait of King George III of Great Britain, 1762
subjects: George III of the United Kingdom
queries: King George III portrait Allan Ramsay

beats.text: King George Third was thrilled and appointed Herschel as his royal astronomer.
beats.visual: Engraving of William Herschel's 40-foot reflecting telescope, 1789
queries: William Herschel 40 foot reflector Slough drawing

beats.text: The king even funded a giant telescope and paid Herschel's sister.
beats.visual: Surviving iron tube section of Herschel's 40-foot telescope at Greenwich, 2012
queries: Herschel 40-foot telescope tube remains Royal Observatory

beats.text: Caroline Herschel became the first woman in England to earn a scientific salary.
beats.visual: Engraved portrait of astronomer Caroline Herschel, 1847

beats.text: But astronomers across the globe flatly rejected putting monarchs into space.
beats.visual: Astronomical map showing the discovery of Uranus in Gemini, 1781

beats.text: They chose the god Uranus over a living British king.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope photograph of Uranus showing polar auroras, 2017

better_than_last: Employs the record structure to highlight the first post-antiquity planet discovery while elevating Caroline Herschel's historical salary twist for maximum rewatch engagement.
